title.narrative: UNICEF has contributed to a transformative digital shift in India's primary healthcare ecosystem strengthening community health worker capabilities, enabling one of the country's most enormous longitudinal health datasets through RCH 2.0 across 20 states, and democratizing evidence through platforms like HealthNutritionIndia.org, with 55,000+ users. By advancing AI-enabled innovations including the DISHA chatbot with 15,000+ users and the ANMOL training chatbot UNICEF has supported India to leverage secure, interoperable data for predictive analytics, equitable service delivery, and real-time decision-making. These efforts collectively mark a step-change in how India tracks, understands, and responds to the needs of every mother and child at scale.
